head.title: Burrow
head.ogTitle: Burrow · A market on hamster hours
head.description: Burrow is a small financial district on Squeekchain that keeps hamster hours: loans, bonds and a share token that all run on one real wheel.

texts390.text: Loans, bonds and Hamster Motors shares run on one real wheel.
Connect a wallet to see its collateral, credit line and debt. To look at another account,
Borrow up to 60% of their value
Your Squeek NFTs appear here once a wallet is connected, or load any address.
every borrower, from the vault's own events
HMTR · every car is a wheel, the CEO is a hamster
Mint with bSQK. Redeem or stake with HMTR. Exit fee: 1% when open, 5% when closed. Market
Connect a wallet to mint with bSQK, redeem or stake HMTR
park HMTR 30 days, drive off with a car
Park at least 100 HMTR. After 30 days, claim a car. Leaving early forfeits an unclaimed ca
Deposit SQK, receive bSQK. Loan interest, marketplace fees and the swap hook fee all raise
mature in wheel work, not days
Lock bSQK for 500 to 1,000,000 wheel work. Early exit forfeits the bonus and costs up to 2
Term in settled wheel work; bonds rest when the wheel is idle.
every fee raises the share price
Burrow has three parts. Loans: lend SQK, or borrow it against Squeek NFTs. Wheel bonds: lo
Deployed source, tests and README: ; every contract is a Sourcify exact match. Unaudited.
